baseline.description: For each event observation, compare against eligible non-event observations from the same ticker and same minute-of-day within the same dataset split.

eligibility_requirements.entry_convention: next executable 1-minute bar open (minute t+1 open)
eligibility_requirements.exit_convention: next_bar_close for 1m (t+1 close), t+2 close for 2m, t+5 close for 5m

primary_1m_mechanics.intended_difference: Only intended difference between event and baseline observations is whether the locked extreme-move event condition fired.

dates_and_splits.holdout_access_rule: Holdout must not be parsed or evaluated unless validation earns the locked supported disposition
dates_and_splits.locked_parameter_discipline: Event threshold, horizons, costs, gates, universe, provider, and outcome definitions must not be changed after looking at development results without creating a new explicitly approved specification version.

spec.direction_notes: Extreme negative 1-minute moves followed by possible positive reversal. Long-side reversal only. No symmetric upside/short hypothesis in v1.

disposition_precedence.holdout_application: The exact same 5-step disposition sequence and precedence rules apply to conditional holdout evaluation.

step_1_invalidity.condition: Methodological or data-integrity failures, including: lookahead or future leakage, premature holdout access, material timestamp or execution invalidity, split contamination (forward outcomes crossing split boundaries), silent provider or feed substitution, or corrupt/unverifiable inputs.

step_2_evidence_sufficiency.condition: Otherwise valid, but any evidence-sufficiency condition fails: fewer than 300 eligible events, fewer than 15 represented tickers, > 15% single-ticker event concentration, or > 5% excluded ticker-sessions due to data-quality defects. Holdout must not be inspected.

step_3_directional_hypothesis_failure.condition: Adequate and valid evidence, but any of the following directional failures occur: primary mean net 1-minute return at 2 bps/side <= 0; mean event-minus-baseline uplift <= 0; or fewer than 60% of represented tickers have positive primary mean net return (breadth gate failure).

step_4_statistical_uncertainty.condition: Required means are positive and breadth passes (>= 60%), but either required 95% CI lower bound is <= 0 (primary net return CI lower bound <= 0 OR uplift CI lower bound <= 0).

step_5_support.condition: All five locked gates pass simultaneously on the evaluated split.

dispositions.inconclusive: Evidence sufficiency fails in Step 2 (<300 events, <15 tickers, >15% concentration, >5% excluded sessions), OR statistical uncertainty fails in Step 4 (CI lower bound <= 0 despite positive means and passing breadth).
dispositions.invalid: Methodological or data-integrity failure in Step 1: lookahead bias, future-data leakage, holdout opened before validation support, timestamp/availability semantics materially wrong, split contamination, silent provider/feed substitution, corrupted or unverifiable data, or execution timing uses event close.
dispositions.rejected: Data and methodology are valid and sufficiently sampled, but directional failure occurs in Step 3: primary net return <= 0, baseline uplift <= 0, or < 60% positive-ticker breadth.

eligibility_and_timing.entry_timing: next executable 1-minute bar open (minute t+1 open)
eligibility_and_timing.latest_event_bar_rule: Full 5-minute outcome horizon must remain inside regular session; cannot cross session close
eligibility_and_timing.opening_minute_reason: 9:30 opening minute may embed overnight gap rather than pure within-session 1-minute move

event_definition.percentile_clarification: 0.1st percentile equals the bottom 1/10th of 1 percent (quantile 0.001), NOT the 10th percentile (quantile 0.10)
event_definition.return_metric: completed regular-session 1-minute close-to-close returns within eligible window

trailing_reference_population.rule: For each ticker and candidate session D, use only the previous 20 completed regular sessions; use only valid 1-minute returns whose bar starts are 09:31 through 15:54 ET inclusive; exclude the 09:30 opening return entirely; use only ticker-sessions not excluded by locked data-quality rules; do not use data from current session D.

event_definition.trailing_window_scope: previous 20 completed regular sessions for that ticker (excluding current session D)

execution_friction.reporting_rule: report gross and all locked net scenarios

governance.daytrade_multi_resolution_boundary: Tests 1-minute statistical phenomenon only; 133-tick and 50-tick data are unauthorized in v1

spec.hypothesis: Among the fixed Dow 30 research universe, an unusually extreme negative completed 1-minute return is followed by a positive short-horizon reversal that exceeds comparable non-event intraday returns after realistic execution friction.

primary_endpoint.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)
primary_endpoint.name: 1_minute_forward_return

secondary_endpoints.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)
secondary_endpoints.name: 2_minute_forward_return

secondary_endpoints.entry: next 1-minute bar open after event detection (t+1 open)
secondary_endpoints.name: 5_minute_forward_return

timestamp_normalization.completion_rule: A 1-minute bar starting at T is not available until T+1 minute (at T+1 close)
timestamp_normalization.signal_availability: Signal is known only after the event minute is completed

algorithm_steps: 1. Resample ticker-session clusters with replacement from the applicable split
2. Retain eligible event and eligible non-event observations contained in those sampled clusters
4. Recompute the matched same-ticker/same-minute baseline using the resampled observations
6. Record both bootstrap statistics (primary event mean and event-minus-baseline uplift)
statistical_inference.description: Deterministic cluster bootstrap by ticker-session with simultaneous recomputation of event and matched baseline statistics.
statistical_inference.joint_recomputation_rule: The 95% CI for uplift must incorporate uncertainty from both event and baseline samples; baseline must NOT be held fixed while resampling events.

spec.study_name: DAYTRADE-001B: Extreme Downside 1-Minute Reversal Research Specification
spec.study_notes: Event-study methodology only; not an executable backtest. Overlapping events may occur and must be reported.

universe.name: DOW30
survivorship_and_selection_limitations: Preset snapshot is from 2026; using it to study 2025 introduces survivorship and constituent-selection limitations.
DAYTRADE-001B accepts that limitation for this first bounded exploratory study.
This study cannot receive an evidence-confidence label above limited_but_usable_evidence solely on the basis of this dataset.
No production promotion may result directly from this study.
Historical Dow constituent reconstruction is out of scope.
